justification: Data insertion script for a new control type (solar_access_hours) across 27 councils. No schema changes, no frontend changes. Uses established insert pattern with dedup check. 12 of 27 rows marked needs_review for PDF verification.

pre_impl.existing_data: dcp_setback_controls table has 823 rows across 28 LGAs. No existing solar_access_hours rows — this is net-new data. Frontend registration for solar_access_hours already merged in PR #350.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: If a council's actual solar requirement differs from the standard 3h assumed for needs_review rows, the value_min will be wrong. Mitigated: needs_review=TRUE flag + review_reason column flag these for manual verification before user-facing display.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: All new rows. dev_type='universal_residential' because solar access applies to all residential development. Dedup check prevents duplicates on re-run.

functions.name: main
functions.input: Command line args (--dry-run flag) and DATABASE_URL from .env file
functions.output: Inserts 27 rows into dcp_setback_controls with control_type='solar_access_hours', prints summary table
functions.if_none: If DATABASE_URL is None, psycopg2.connect raises OperationalError with clear connection failure message

values.nullable: yes — if neither DATABASE_URL nor SUPABASE_DB_URL set in .env
values.guard_at: N/A — psycopg2.connect will raise on None
values.if_missing: Script crashes with psycopg2 connection error — visible, not silent

values.nullable: no — every SOLAR_ROWS entry has an explicit integer value_min (2, 3, or 4)
values.if_missing: KeyError on row access — script crashes visibly

values.nullable: no — every row explicitly sets needs_review to True or False

queries.purpose: Dedup check — prevents inserting duplicate solar_access_hours for same LGA
queries.where_clause: WHERE lga = %s AND control_type = 'solar_access_hours' AND dev_type = 'universal_residential' AND is_current = TRUE
queries.if_zero: Row is new — proceeds to INSERT
queries.if_wrong: If an older solar row exists with different value, it will be skipped. To update, set old row is_current=FALSE first.

queries.purpose: INSERT new solar access control row
queries.if_wrong: Wrong value_min would show incorrect hours in DcpStructuredControls. Mitigated by needs_review flag for unverified councils.

break_it.scenario: A needs_review row has wrong value_min (e.g., council actually requires 4 hours but we inserted 3) and user sees incorrect DCP requirement
break_it.what_happens: User sees '3 hours' when council actually requires 4 hours — could lead to non-compliant design
break_it.how: scripts/insert_solar_access_hours.py:55-270 — 12 rows have needs_review=TRUE and source_text explicitly says 'Assumed — needs PDF verification'. Frontend should surface review status to internal team.

break_it.scenario: Script run twice inserts duplicate rows creating double-counted solar requirements
break_it.what_happens: API returns two solar_access_hours entries for same council — confusing UI display
break_it.how: scripts/insert_solar_access_hours.py:301 — dedup SELECT before INSERT checks (lga, control_type, dev_type, is_current). Exact match → skip.

break_it.scenario: Canterbury-Bankstown has non-standard time windows (8am-4pm living, 9am-5pm equinox POS) which differ from what user expects when seeing '3 hours'
break_it.what_happens: User assumes standard 9am-3pm window but actual requirement uses 8am-4pm for living areas and equinox for POS
break_it.how: scripts/insert_solar_access_hours.py:128 — full condition text captures both time windows. DcpStructuredControls renders condition text alongside the numeric value.

break_it.scenario: Dedup SELECT query fails due to DB connection timeout or schema mismatch (e.g., column renamed), causing script to crash mid-run with some rows inserted and others not
break_it.what_happens: Partial insertion — some councils have solar data, others don't. Inconsistent coverage visible in UI.
break_it.how: scripts/insert_solar_access_hours.py:350 — conn.commit() only called after ALL rows processed successfully. If any query fails, transaction is uncommitted and no rows are written. Script is idempotent on re-run via dedup check.

post_merge.manual_verify: Yes — run the script against production DB: python scripts/insert_solar_access_hours.py. Then verify with: SELECT lga, value_min, needs_review FROM dcp_setback_controls WHERE control_type = 'solar_access_hours' AND is_current = TRUE ORDER BY lga;
